Title: Aditya and the Family

Cast

1. Aditya - 12 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Isha - 10 years, daughter
Look: glasses, blue dress
3. Pallavi - 37 years, mother
Look: green saree

Places

1. The park - green grass, swings, benches
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
3. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
4. The road - a paved road, trees along it

Scene 1: The park - Day

[Aditya stands in the park. Pallavi stands near him.]

Aditya: "Let's do something fun today."

[Aditya kicks the football hard.]

Pallavi: "Oh wow!"

[Aditya swings on the swing.]

Aditya (gently): "Yes, of course."

[Aditya plays on the see-saw with Mother.]

Aditya (excited): "Oh wow!"

[Aditya plays with his dog.]

Aditya: "Really?"

[Aditya feeds the birds.]

Pallavi (surprised): "Good job, Aditya!"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Aditya stands in the living room. Isha and Pallavi stand near him.]

Pallavi: "What a nice place."

[Aditya combs his hair in front of the mirror.]

Pallavi (laughing): "Hmm, I see."

[Isha applies kajal to her eyes.]

Aditya (surprised): "Hey, look at that!"

[Isha puts on red lipstick.]

Aditya: "Really?"

[Isha puts a bindi on her forehead.]

Pallavi (laughing): "Slowly, take it easy."

Scene 3: The courtyard - Day

[Aditya stands in the courtyard. Pallavi stands near him.]

Aditya: "So, here we are!"

[Aditya carries his school bag on his back.]

Aditya: "What next?"

[Aditya slips and falls.]

Aditya: "Hmm, I see."

[Aditya trips over a stone.]

Aditya: "Mom, listen!"

[Aditya sneezes loudly.]

Pallavi (surprised): "What next?"

Scene 4: The road - Day

[Aditya stands by the road. Pallavi stands near him.]

Aditya: "Mom, look over here."

[Aditya rides his bicycle down the road.]

Aditya: "What next?"

[Aditya gets into the car.]

Aditya: "That's easy."

[Aditya gets on the bus.]

Pallavi (gently): "Show me too!"

[Aditya gets off the school bus.]

Aditya: "Wow, how lovely!"

[Aditya hops into an auto-rickshaw.]

Pallavi: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
